name: Will Anderson

bio.statement: A City of Milwaukie councilor page lists Anderson as a city councilor first elected May 21, 2024.
Anderson's pamphlet statement lists political science study at Stanford University and work as a healthcare policy advocate and chief of staff.
bio.excerpt: Healthcare Policy Advocate; Chief of Staff

bio.statement: Anderson's pamphlet statement lists service as city council president and Safe Routes to School Committee chair.
bio.excerpt: City Council President, Safe Routes to School Committee Chair, Clackamas County Coordinating Committee

positions.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Anderson says he will cut red tape to build affordable housing and lower utility costs.
positions.excerpt: I’ll cut red tape to build affordable housing and lower utility costs.

positions.statement: Anderson's pamphlet statement says Milwaukie cannot be the community residents love unless people can afford to live there.
positions.excerpt: Milwaukie can’t be the community we love unless people can afford to live here.

positions.statement: Anderson's pamphlet statement says he helped hire two police officers and a behavioral health specialist and secured $600k for road safety.
positions.excerpt: I helped hire two new police officers and a behavioral health specialist and secured $600k for safety improvements to our roads.

positions.statement: Anderson's pamphlet statement envisions safe streets for children, well-maintained roads and quick police response.
positions.excerpt: I envision a city where kids can safely play outside, our streets are pothole-free and well maintained, and police respond quickly.
